violations.title_en: Unauthorised construction / occupation on land vested in the Municipal Corporation
violations.title_hi: नगर निगम में निहित भूमि पर अनधिकृत निर्माण / कब्ज़ा
violations.description: Any building, boundary wall, shed, hut, platform or structure raised on land vested in the Corporation (parks, green belts, community sites, road land, drain land, municipal plots, village common land vested after inclusion) without allotment, lease or permission.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 408 and 408A of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (unauthorised occupation of / encroachment on land vested in the Corporation)
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Screenshot of the government-land layer showing the point inside the parcel
Khasra/parcel number from the land record layer
Photograph of any boundary pillars / demarcation
violations.appeal: Commissioner, within 7 days of the order (s.408B)
violations.notes: Competent authority is the Joint Commissioner (s.2(4A)). Notice may be served by post, in person or by affixation / beat of drum (s.408A(1)). Cost of demolition recoverable as arrears of land revenue.

violations.title_en: Encroachment / unauthorised construction on State Government land or other public premises
violations.title_hi: राज्य सरकार की भूमि / अन्य सार्वजनिक परिसर पर अतिक्रमण / अनधिकृत निर्माण
violations.description: Construction on land belonging to the State Government or a Government department/board/corporation (e.g., HSVP, GMDA, PWD, Irrigation, Forest, Panchayat land not vested in MCG). MCG records the violation, issues stop-work / demolition proceedings for the building under the HMC Act and refers eviction to the Collector under the Public Premises Act.
violations.contravention_of: Section 3 of the Haryana Public Premises and Land (Eviction and Rent Recovery) Act, 1972 read with sections 250 and 254(2)(e) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Screenshot of the government-land layer showing the point inside the parcel
Khasra/parcel number from the land record layer
Photograph of any boundary pillars / demarcation
Letter / e-mail to the land-owning department and the Collector (DC) office
violations.appeal: Appeal under s.9 HPPA 1972
violations.notes: Eviction under HPPA is by the Collector (DC/SDM). The system generates the referral letter and tracks the DC-office reference; the building itself is proceeded against under s.261 (no sanction possible on Government land, s.254(2)(e)).

violations.title_en: Structure / fixture erected on public street, footpath or road land
violations.title_hi: सार्वजनिक सड़क, फुटपाथ या रोड-लैंड पर संरचना / फिक्सचर का निर्माण
violations.description: Walls, fences, rails, posts, steps, ramps, booths, kiosks, sheds or any permanent or temporary structure or fixture erected on any street or footpath, or over a drain, channel or well in a street, forming an obstruction or encroachment.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 235 and 238(1) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Measurement of the encroached width of the street/footpath
Road/street name and right-of-way width
violations.appeal: Notice under s.235(2); summary removal u/s 240/243(3)

violations.title_en: Construction within the regular line of a street / building line
violations.title_hi: सड़क की नियमित रेखा / भवन रेखा के भीतर निर्माण
violations.description: Any portion of a building erected, re-erected or added within the regular line of a public street or the building line fixed by the Corporation, or in contravention of a sanctioned scheme/plan.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 224/225 and 258(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Regular line of street / building line from the sanctioned layout
Measured distance of the structure from the road centre line
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Projection over street without permission (balcony, canopy, sunshade, ramp, steps)
violations.title_hi: बिना अनुमति सड़क पर प्रक्षेपण (बालकनी, कैनोपी, छज्जा, रैम्प, सीढ़ियाँ)
violations.description: Balconies, canopies, chajjas, awnings, signboards, ramps, steps or other things projecting over or on to a street beyond the plot boundary without written permission of the Commissioner, or beyond the permitted extent.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 235 and 236 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 read with Code 7.12 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Measured projection beyond plot line (metres)
violations.appeal: Notice under s.235(2); summary removal u/s 240/243(3)

violations.title_en: Construction on or over a municipal drain, nallah, water body, pond or johad
violations.title_hi: नगरपालिका नाले, नाली, जलाशय, तालाब या जोहड़ पर / के ऊपर निर्माण
violations.description: Structures raised on, over or into a municipal drain, storm-water nallah, natural water course, pond/johad or its embankment so as to interfere with its working, inspection or cleansing, or encroach upon land vested in the Corporation.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 235(1)(b), 238(1) and 408/408A of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Screenshot of the government-land layer showing the point inside the parcel
Khasra/parcel number from the land record layer
Photograph of any boundary pillars / demarcation
Drain/nallah name and the GIS drainage layer screenshot
violations.appeal: Commissioner, within 7 days of the order (s.408B)
violations.notes: Water bodies: also check Haryana Pond and Waste Water Management Authority Act, 2018 and NGT directions; refer to the Executive Engineer (Drainage).

violations.title_en: Construction on land reserved for public purpose in a sanctioned scheme / layout (park, green belt, community site, road)
violations.title_hi: स्वीकृत योजना / लेआउट में सार्वजनिक प्रयोजन हेतु आरक्षित भूमि (पार्क, ग्रीन बेल्ट, सामुदायिक स्थल, सड़क) पर निर्माण
violations.description: Buildings on sites earmarked in the sanctioned layout / development plan / building scheme for parks, open spaces, roads, community facilities or other public purposes.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 254(2)(g), 258(2) and 267 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (and section 7 of the Punjab Scheduled Roads and Controlled Areas Restriction of Unregulated Development Act, 1963 where the site is in a controlled area)
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Screenshot of the government-land layer showing the point inside the parcel
Khasra/parcel number from the land record layer
Photograph of any boundary pillars / demarcation
Extract of sanctioned layout / zoning plan showing reservation
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Deposit of building material / malba on street or public land without permission
violations.title_hi: बिना अनुमति सड़क या सार्वजनिक भूमि पर निर्माण सामग्री / मलबा जमा करना
violations.description: Building material, debris (malba), sand, bricks, scaffolding or enclosures placed on a street or public place without written permission of the Commissioner.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 238(2) and 243(1) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (also Construction & Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016)
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
violations.appeal: Notice under s.235(2); summary removal u/s 240/243(3)
violations.notes: Summary removal without notice permitted (s.243(3)); link the C&D waste challan module for the malba lifting charge.

violations.title_en: Erection of building without sanction of building plan
violations.title_hi: भवन योजना की स्वीकृति के बिना भवन का निर्माण
violations.description: New construction commenced, in progress or completed on a private plot without the previous sanction of the Commissioner (no BR-I application / no sanctioned plan / no self-certification intimation).
violations.contravention_of: Section 250 read with section 251 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 2.1 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))
violations.notes: Regularisation possible only if the construction is otherwise in conformity with the Code and a plan is sanctioned with composition charges; ground-coverage violations are non-compoundable (HBC 6.3).

violations.title_en: Addition / alteration / structural repair without sanction
violations.title_hi: स्वीकृति के बिना जोड़ / परिवर्तन / संरचनात्मक मरम्मत
violations.description: Additional floor, room, extension, removal or re-erection of external/partition/load-bearing walls, sub-division of rooms, closing of external openings, relocation of principal staircase or other works listed in section 252 executed without sanction.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 250 and 252 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 4.6 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Construction continued after expiry / lapse of sanction validity
violations.title_hi: स्वीकृति की वैधता समाप्त होने के बाद निर्माण जारी रखना
violations.description: Work continued beyond the completion period specified in the sanction or after the sanction lapsed without re-validation / fresh sanction.
violations.contravention_of: Section 259 read with section 255(3) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Codes 4.3-4.4 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Sanction letter showing validity / completion period
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Sanction obtained by misrepresentation or fraudulent documents
violations.title_hi: गलत बयानी या कूटरचित दस्तावेज़ों से प्राप्त स्वीकृति
violations.description: Sanction/self-certification found to be based on material misrepresentation, forged ownership papers or false certificates; on cancellation the construction is deemed to be without sanction.
violations.contravention_of: Section 256 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 4.7 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Copy of the impugned document and the verification report (revenue / registrar)
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))
violations.notes: Also refer the Architect to the Council of Architecture (HBC 2.2(3)) and consider a police complaint for forgery (BNS 2023 ss.336-340).

violations.title_en: Commencement of work without notice of commencement / DPC certificate
violations.title_hi: प्रारंभ की सूचना / डी.पी.सी. प्रमाण-पत्र के बिना कार्य प्रारंभ
violations.description: Construction started without giving the notice of the proposed date of commencement (and DPC-level certificate) required after sanction.
violations.contravention_of: Section 255(4) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 4.9 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Illegal colony / unauthorised plotting or layout / roads laid without sanction
violations.title_hi: अवैध कॉलोनी / अनधिकृत प्लॉटिंग या लेआउट / बिना स्वीकृति सड़कें बनाना
violations.description: Land divided into plots, streets laid out, boundary walls/plinths raised or plots sold on the ground without a sanctioned layout plan / licence.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 230-232 and 254(2)(d) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (and section 7 of the 1963 Act / section 3 of the Haryana Development and Regulation of Urban Areas Act, 1975 where applicable)
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Drone / satellite imagery of the layout
Khasra numbers and area under plotting
Details of the coloniser / developer and any sale deeds
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))
violations.notes: Co-ordinate with DTP (Enforcement) where the land is in a controlled area outside the sanctioned layout; the app generates the referral.

violations.title_en: Construction contrary to sanctioned plan / in contravention of conditions of sanction
violations.title_hi: स्वीकृत नक्शे के विपरीत / स्वीकृति की शर्तों का उल्लंघन करते हुए निर्माण
violations.description: Any deviation from the sanctioned drawings or the conditions of sanction not covered by a revised sanction (general head; use the specific codes below where the deviation is identifiable).
violations.contravention_of: Section 255(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 4.6 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Ground coverage in excess of permissible limit
violations.title_hi: अनुमेय सीमा से अधिक ग्राउंड कवरेज
violations.description: Covered area at ground/any floor exceeding the permissible ground coverage for the plot category; non-compoundable under the Code.
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.3 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 255(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Measured coverage (sq m) vs permitted (sq m and %)
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Floor Area Ratio (FAR) / additional floor beyond permissible
violations.title_hi: अनुमेय से अधिक एफ.ए.आर. / अतिरिक्त मंज़िल
violations.description: Total covered area exceeding the permissible FAR, or floors constructed beyond the number sanctioned/permissible for the plot (e.g., 5th floor on a plot permitted S+4).
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.3 (FAR) of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 255(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Measured FAR vs permitted FAR
Number of floors sanctioned vs constructed
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))
violations.notes: Purchasable FAR / composition may regularise excess FAR only within the limits and on the charges notified by the Government.

violations.title_en: Violation of front / side / rear setbacks
violations.title_hi: आगे / बगल / पीछे के सेटबैक का उल्लंघन
violations.description: Construction within the mandatory open spaces (setbacks) around the building, including covering of setbacks with rooms, porticos beyond limits or sheds.
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.3 (setbacks) of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with sections 255(2) and 263 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Measured setbacks (m) on each side vs required
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Building height beyond permissible
violations.title_hi: अनुमेय से अधिक भवन की ऊँचाई
violations.description: Height of building (including mumty/parapet where counted) exceeding the permissible height for the plot / zone (e.g., 15 m for residential plotted with stilt).
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.3 (height) of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 255(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Measured height (m) vs permitted
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Basement constructed without sanction / beyond permitted extent or misused
violations.title_hi: स्वीकृति के बिना / अनुमत सीमा से अधिक बेसमेंट या उसका दुरुपयोग
violations.description: Basement dug or built without sanction, extending beyond the permitted footprint/setbacks, or used for habitation/commerce against the Code.
violations.contravention_of: Code 7.16 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with sections 250 and 265(1) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Structural safety concern noted (adjoining buildings)
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Stilt parking covered / converted or parking not provided as sanctioned
violations.title_hi: स्टिल्ट पार्किंग को ढकना / बदलना या स्वीकृत पार्किंग उपलब्ध न कराना
violations.description: Stilt floor sanctioned for parking enclosed into rooms/shops, or mandatory parking spaces used for other purposes.
violations.contravention_of: Codes 6.3 and 7.1 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with sections 263 and 265(1) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Unauthorised sub-division of plot / more than one building unit on a plot
violations.title_hi: प्लॉट का अनधिकृत उप-विभाजन / एक प्लॉट पर एक से अधिक भवन इकाई
violations.description: Plot split into independent units with separate access/staircases, or more dwelling units than permitted, without approval.
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.2 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 254(2)(d) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Number of independent units / kitchens / meters
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Unauthorised amalgamation of plots
violations.title_hi: प्लॉटों का अनधिकृत समामेलन
violations.description: Two or more plots built upon as one unit without approval of amalgamation or in violation of the zoning for the amalgamated plot.
violations.contravention_of: Code 6.2 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Violation of zoning plan / architectural control sheet
violations.title_hi: ज़ोनिंग प्लान / आर्किटेक्चरल कंट्रोल शीट का उल्लंघन
violations.description: Building not conforming to the zoning plan or architectural control sheet applicable to the plot (e.g., shop-cum-flat sites, booths, sector commercial).
violations.contravention_of: Codes 3.5 and 6.4 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 255(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Copy of the zoning plan / control sheet
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Mezzanine, mumty, pergola, chajja or projection beyond permitted limits
violations.title_hi: अनुमत सीमा से अधिक मेज़ेनाइन, मुमटी, पेर्गोला, छज्जा या प्रक्षेपण
violations.description: Mezzanine floors, mumty, pergolas, chajjas or cantilevered projections exceeding the dimensions permitted by the Code.
violations.contravention_of: Codes 7.12 and 7.13 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017 read with section 263 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
violations.appeal: Show cause under s.263(1)(b); order under s.263(3); thereafter s.261 remedies

violations.title_en: Change of use of land or building without permission (e.g., residential to commercial, PG, guest house, godown)
violations.title_hi: बिना अनुमति भूमि या भवन के उपयोग में परिवर्तन (जैसे आवासीय से व्यावसायिक, पी.जी., गेस्ट हाउस, गोदाम)
violations.description: Use of premises for a purpose other than the sanctioned/permitted use without written permission of the Commissioner or Change of Land Use.
violations.contravention_of: Section 265(1)(b) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Codes 4.12 and 6.1 of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Photographs of signage / commercial activity
Trade licence / GST / electricity connection category if available
violations.appeal: Notice u/s 265(1); revocation of OC after personal hearing (HBC 4.12)
violations.notes: Sealing under s.263A is available where the misuse is coupled with unauthorised construction; otherwise proceed under s.265(1), OC revocation and prosecution u/s 380.

violations.title_en: Occupation / use of building without completion / occupation certificate
violations.title_hi: पूर्णता / अधिभोग प्रमाण-पत्र के बिना भवन का अधिभोग / उपयोग
violations.description: Building or part occupied or used before the completion notice was given and occupation permission (OC) granted / deemed.
violations.contravention_of: Section 264(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 and Code 4.10(2) of the Haryana Building Code, 2017
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Evidence of occupation (residents, electricity/water connection)
violations.appeal: Order u/s 266(1) with reasons; police removal u/s 266(2)

violations.title_en: Use of inflammable materials for roof / shed / pandal without permission
violations.title_hi: बिना अनुमति छत / शेड / पंडाल में ज्वलनशील सामग्री का उपयोग
violations.description: Roof, verandah, pandal, wall, shed or fence constructed of cloth, grass, leaves, mats or other inflammable material in an area specified by bye-laws without written permission.
violations.contravention_of: Section 260 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
violations.appeal: Notice under s.235(2); summary removal u/s 240/243(3)

violations.title_en: Dangerous / ruinous structure likely to fall
violations.title_hi: खतरनाक / जर्जर संरचना जिसके गिरने की संभावना है
violations.description: Building or wall in a ruinous condition, likely to fall or otherwise dangerous to occupants, neighbours or passers-by.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 265(2) and 315 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Structural condition photographs (cracks, tilt)
Engineer's preliminary assessment
violations.appeal: Order under s.265(2); Commissioner may act forthwith if danger imminent (s.265(4))

violations.title_en: Building unfit for human habitation
violations.title_hi: मानव निवास के लिए अनुपयुक्त भवन
violations.description: Building unfit for human habitation and not capable of being rendered fit at reasonable expense (repair, stability, damp, light/air, water, drainage, sanitation).
violations.contravention_of: Sections 282 to 284 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Health Officer / Engineer inspection report
violations.appeal: Show cause u/s 284(1); undertaking u/s 284(2)
violations.notes: Statutory sequence: SCN -> undertaking (284(2)) -> demolition order with >=30 days to vacate and demolition within 6 weeks thereafter (284(3)).

violations.title_en: Continuing construction after stop-work order
violations.title_hi: कार्य-रोक आदेश के बाद निर्माण जारी रखना
violations.description: Erection or work continued after service of a stop-work order under s.262(1) / s.261 second proviso.
violations.contravention_of: Section 262(2) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (disobedience of stop-work order) read with section 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Copy of the stop-work order and proof of service
Dated photographs showing progress after service
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Failure to comply with demolition order / alteration notice
violations.title_hi: ध्वस्तीकरण आदेश / परिवर्तन नोटिस का पालन न करना
violations.description: Person on whom a demolition order (s.261/408A) or alteration notice (s.263) was served has not complied within the period specified.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 261(6), 263(2) and 408A(3) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Copy of order and proof of service
Photographs on the day after expiry
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Breaking / removal of seal
violations.title_hi: सील तोड़ना / हटाना
violations.description: Seal affixed under s.263A removed or broken without an order of the Commissioner or the appellate authority.
violations.contravention_of: Section 263A(3) of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 read with section 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Photograph of the broken seal with the sealing memo number
Police DDR / FIR number
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Removal / defacing of notice affixed on premises
violations.title_hi: परिसर पर चस्पा नोटिस को हटाना / विरूपित करना
violations.description: Notice/order affixed on the premises removed, destroyed or defaced without authority.
violations.contravention_of: Section 407 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photo of the affixed notice (from delivery proof)
Geotagged photo showing removal / defacement
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Obstruction of Corporation officials during inspection / enforcement
violations.title_hi: निरीक्षण / प्रवर्तन के दौरान निगम अधिकारियों को बाधा पहुँचाना
violations.description: Officials obstructed, threatened or prevented from inspecting the premises or executing an order.
violations.contravention_of: Section 405 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 read with section 221 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
evidence_checklist: Video of the incident
Names / description of persons obstructing
Police DDR number
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))

violations.title_en: Construction in controlled area / scheduled-road restricted belt without CLU / permission
violations.title_hi: नियंत्रित क्षेत्र / अनुसूचित सड़क प्रतिबंधित पट्टी में सी.एल.यू. / अनुमति के बिना निर्माण
violations.description: Building within a controlled area or the restricted belt along a scheduled road, without Change of Land Use / permission of the Director, Town & Country Planning, where the area lies within municipal limits.
violations.contravention_of: Sections 3 and 7 of the Punjab Scheduled Roads and Controlled Areas Restriction of Unregulated Development Act, 1963 read with section 250 of the Haryana Municipal Corporation Act, 1994
evidence_checklist: Geotagged photographs of the structure from the street (front, both sides)
Geotagged close-up of the violating portion
Short video walk-through (max 60 s)
Site plan / sketch with measurements
PID or address, owner/occupier name and mobile
Name of person supervising construction on site
Sanctioned plan number, date and licence/BR-I reference
Measured vs permitted values (coverage, FAR, setbacks, height)
DPC certificate / stage-completion records if any
Controlled-area / scheduled-road layer screenshot
violations.appeal: Divisional Commissioner, within the period specified in the order (s.261(2)); sealing: 7 days (s.263A(4))
violations.notes: Where DTCP is the enforcing authority, MCG issues the referral and continues proceedings for the building under the HMC Act.
